Build new data to predict at

Source: R/kb_new_data.R
kb_new_data.Rd

Build a grid of rows to predict at: one row per fitted site, year, or observed site-year, or per supplied site or year, crossed for a weight or cover calibration fit with a sequence of its predictor.

Usage

kb_new_data(fit, by = NULL, ...)

Arguments

fit

A kb_fit_weight, kb_fit_size, or kb_fit_cover_calibration object.

by

A character vector of grouping factors giving the rows of the grid. One of:

  • NULL: no grouping columns (the typical site and year).

  • "site": one row per fitted site.

  • "year": one row per fitted year.

  • c("site", "year"): one row per site-year.

...

Named values to cross into the grid: for a weight or cover calibration fit, the predictor values as a numeric vector (diameter_mm, fronds, or cover); and the levels of site or year not named in by. If the predictor is omitted, 30 evenly spaced values span the observed range for weight (whole numbers for fronds), and 0 to 1 for cover.

Value

A tibble with the grouping columns named in by or ..., the predictor column for a weight or cover calibration fit, and for a cover calibration fit the survey columns.

Details

Pass the result as new_data to the model's prediction function, for example kb_predict_size(fit, kb_new_data(fit, by = "site")). The grouping factors not named in by are absent from the grid, so the prediction treats them as set by new_levels: with the default "average", the typical site or year.

For a cover calibration fit, the predictor cover is the tide-corrected proportion of the plot covered by canopy (0 to 1); each row is then a unit plot at zero tide height, with the in situ survey columns that give that cover. A single predictor value gives one row per group at that value.

To fix a grouping factor at chosen levels, supply them by name in ..., for example year = 2021 with by = "site" for every fitted site in 2021, or site = "otter_cove", year = 2022:2025. Each value is crossed with the rest of the grid. A level not in the fit, such as a future year, is a new level, treated as set by new_levels.

by = c("site", "year") gives only the site-years in the fitted data. The result is a tibble; rows can be filtered and columns added before predicting.

See also

Other prediction functions: autoplot.kb_predictions(), kb_plot_predictions(), kb_predict_biomass_canopy(), kb_predict_biomass_in_situ(), kb_predict_carbon(), kb_predict_cover_calibration(), kb_predict_mean_weight(), kb_predict_nitrogen(), kb_predict_size(), kb_predict_weight(), kb_predict_wetdry(), predict.kb_fit_carbon(), predict.kb_fit_cover_calibration(), predict.kb_fit_nitrogen(), predict.kb_fit_size(), predict.kb_fit_weight(), predict.kb_fit_wetdry()

Examples

kb_new_data(fit_size_sim_nereo, by = "site")
#> # A tibble: 9 × 1
#>   site          
#>   <fct>         
#> 1 otter_cove    
#> 2 gull_rock     
#> 3 cedar_bay     
#> 4 heron_reef    
#> 5 urchin_shoal  
#> 6 sculpin_head  
#> 7 eagle_spit    
#> 8 fog_islet     
#> 9 tidepool_bluff

# Weight curves by site, and weight at 50 mm by site:
kb_new_data(fit_weight_sim_nereo, by = "site")
#> # A tibble: 180 × 2
#>    site       diameter_mm
#>    <fct>            <dbl>
#>  1 otter_cove        3.8 
#>  2 otter_cove        6.12
#>  3 otter_cove        8.45
#>  4 otter_cove       10.8 
#>  5 otter_cove       13.1 
#>  6 otter_cove       15.4 
#>  7 otter_cove       17.7 
#>  8 otter_cove       20.1 
#>  9 otter_cove       22.4 
#> 10 otter_cove       24.7 
#> # ℹ 170 more rows
kb_new_data(fit_weight_sim_nereo, by = "site", diameter_mm = 50)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 2
#>   site       diameter_mm
#>   <fct>            <dbl>
#> 1 otter_cove          50
#> 2 gull_rock           50
#> 3 cedar_bay           50
#> 4 heron_reef          50
#> 5 eagle_spit          50
#> 6 fog_islet           50

# Every site in 2021, and one site across years:
kb_new_data(fit_weight_sim_nereo, by = "site", diameter_mm = 50, year = 2021)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   site       year  diameter_mm
#>   <fct>      <chr>       <dbl>
#> 1 otter_cove 2021           50
#> 2 gull_rock  2021           50
#> 3 cedar_bay  2021           50
#> 4 heron_reef 2021           50
#> 5 eagle_spit 2021           50
#> 6 fog_islet  2021           50
kb_new_data(fit_size_sim_nereo, site = "otter_cove", year = 2022:2025)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 2
#>   site       year 
#>   <chr>      <chr>
#> 1 otter_cove 2022 
#> 2 otter_cove 2023 
#> 3 otter_cove 2024 
#> 4 otter_cove 2025 

kb_predict_size(fit_size_sim_nereo, kb_new_data(fit_size_sim_nereo, by = "site"))
#> <kb_predictions> response: diameter_mm | by: site
#> # A tibble: 9 × 4
#>   site           estimate lower upper
#>   <fct>             <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 otter_cove         25.6  23.3  28  
#> 2 gull_rock          27.5  25    30.3
#> 3 cedar_bay          22.4  20.5  24.8
#> 4 heron_reef         24.4  22.1  26.9
#> 5 urchin_shoal       18.7  16.7  21.3
#> 6 sculpin_head       22.4  20.5  24.6
#> 7 eagle_spit         29.1  26.6  31.9
#> 8 fog_islet          31.8  28.1  36  
#> 9 tidepool_bluff     27.3  25    30.1
